description: Continuous layer bands on the hull exterior without islands (CHANGELOG 2026-10-14, band lift): the pits over the gunwales are filled with the band lift (LIFT_MODE band: the surrounding layer lines continued across the pit, no closed rings) at a gentle slope (ISLAND_LIFT_SLOPE 0.16, ~0.8 mm of step per 0.13 mm layer), and a little more tilt (MAX_OVERHANG 25) shrinks an unsupported skin at the stern (part frame x 23, z 42) from 22 to 2.5 mm. Vs the built-in defaults: hull layer_turns 538 -> 390 (no lift 384); ungrounded walls 21.9 -> 2.9 mm, island walls 10.5 -> 4.6 mm, cantilever walls 1.0 -> 9.8 mm; tilt 49 -> 52 deg.
